training.note: One-minute smoke-training run (configs/classic_intro.json via scripts/train_one_minute.sh) on Easy track 0 (Intro) / 100cc only. Re-bundled after the observation vector grew from 28 to 36 values (added an 8-ray obstacle-distance sensor over the track polyline); this is a pipeline smoke result, not a tuned sweep result.

reference_evaluation.note: Deterministic same-track evaluation (Easy track 0, Intro); not a general performance claim across other tracks or leagues. A subsequent all-tracks curriculum run from this checkpoint reached 21/30 tracks with at least one training-time finish before its final checkpoint collapsed to 0% on a formal 30-track evaluation; see docs/policy-comparison.md.
